purpose: Freeze the exact XBRL construction for institutional-demand-by-accrual research before historical PIT compilation.

formula.state: POSITIVE_ACCRUAL when accrual_intensity > 0; NEGATIVE_ACCRUAL when accrual_intensity < 0; ZERO_ACCRUAL when exactly 0

fact_contract.duration_alignment: NetIncomeLoss and NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities must share the same fiscal duration and fiscal period; Assets_current is the instant fact at the current period end and Assets_prior is the immediately preceding comparable period-end Assets fact.
fact_contract.selection_rule: Choose the latest filing accepted no later than the decision cutoff that contains all three required concepts with a valid duration/instant alignment. No concept substitution is allowed.
fact_contract.amendment_rule: An amended filing may supersede an earlier filing only through its later SEC acceptance timestamp; accession lineage is retained.
fact_contract.units: USD-equivalent numeric values after XBRL unit validation; no cross-unit coercion.

missingness: If any required concept or valid aligned prior-period Assets fact is missing, the accrual state is MISSING rather than imputed.

institutional_component.state_basis: issuer-level sign of manager transition counts: INCREASE+NEW minus DECREASE+EXIT
institutional_component.neutral_rule: ZERO when the count difference is exactly zero or no eligible transitions exist

pit_boundary: A filing contributes only after its SEC acceptance timestamp; the joined issuer state uses the first eligible XNYS session strictly after the acceptance date.
mutation_requirements: future SEC acceptance after cutoff cannot alter prior state
amendment accession remains distinct and later accepted amendment supersedes earlier filing only at its acceptance boundary
missing prior Assets fact yields MISSING, not imputation
next_gate: historical SEC 13F archive/security completeness + concept-specific PIT compiler + independent reproduction
